status.en: 54 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 39% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Kabul and Peshawar.
status.nb: 54 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 39 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Peshawar.

summary.en: Security forces killed eight terrorists in operations in Peshawar and Bannu, while armed men killed a former soldier in Kabul. A drone strike in Mastung killed one civilian and injured two children, and a forest fire in Kunar killed two children and burned over ten jeribs of forest. Residents of Bajaur district died in a shipwreck off Libya, and the closure of the Pakistan border has stalled fish and meat trade in Helmand. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker drepte åtte terrorister i operasjoner i Peshawar og Bannu, mens bevæpnede menn drepte en tidligere soldat i Kabul. Et droneangrep i Mastung drepte en sivil og såret to barn, og en skogbrann i Kunar drepte to barn og brente over ti jerib skog. Innbyggere i Bajaur-distriktet døde i et skipsforlis utenfor Libya, og stengingen av Pakistan-grensen har stoppet fisk- og kjøtthandel i Helmand. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
